Research and knowledge exchange Alumni Videos The Real London London Metropolitan University International Study abroad Custom programmes Custom programmes Custom study abroad programmes for your institution Bring your students to the heart of real London where people live, work and study together in a vibrant academic community. Offer them real experiences as they study in an institution brimming with diversity. Here at London Met, we can support your institution in offering custom faculty-led programmes throughout the year. Our service is bespoke and we will work with you to develop and deliver your programme. Our support is flexible and allows you to select only the elements you need. Get in touch Interested in running your own custom programme or finding out more? Leave us your details or contact us at studyabroad@londonmet.ac.uk . Tuition and guest lectures London Met has fantastic teaching staff across our five academic schools: Guildhall School of Business and Law School of Computing and Digital Media School of Art, Architecture and Design School of Human Sciences School of Social Sciences and Professions Guest lecturers are available for one-day visits, workshops or short programmes. We can also provide credit-bearing modules for a variety of programme lengths. Classroom rental Our central London campuses are well connected and easily accessible by tube, bus and even walking. We offer classroom rental* as well as workshop and lecture hall space at our two campuses in Aldgate and Holloway. We'll work with you to find the right classroom space for your teaching and learning activities. Examples of classroom rentals T1-20 Roding Building second floor breakout space TM2-01 IT suite Henry Thomas Room TG-30 TM3-03 TM1-83 Previous Next Housing We work with a range of student housing providers* across the city. We can help you find somewhere safe, affordable and comfortable for your students to live during their programme. Excursions and social activities Learning goes well beyond the classroom. Our local social event company offers preferential rates and we can help to organise trips across the UK and Europe. This can include London sightseeing tours, Oxford and Stonehenge excursions, and more. Example excursions Canterbury Cathedral Tower Bridge Windsor Castle London skyline London Eye Dover Castle Stratford-upon-Avon White Cliffs of Dover Stonehenge Punting along the River Cam in Cambridge Bath city centre Bridge of Sighs in Oxford Roman baths in Bath Radcliffe Camera Oxford Previous Next Administrative support and London guidance Our dedicated and experienced study abroad team are on hand to provide local knowledge.
